ai_positioning.summary: Booz Allen Hamilton se positionne comme un intégrateur de technologies avancées, notamment l'IA, pour les missions critiques du gouvernement américain et les clients commerciaux. L'entreprise met l'accent sur l'application de l'IA pour transformer les missions et protéger la nation.
evidence: As an advanced technology company, we build technology solutions using AI, cyber, and other cutting-edge technologies to advance and protect the nation and its citizens.
By focusing on outcomes, we enable our people and customers to transform missions for the nation.

Drawing on our deep expertise and leading position as a cybersecurity provider, we bring advanced tradecraft to commercial customers across industries, including financial services, health and life sciences, energy, and technology.
ai_positioning.source: Item 7 Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
